_comment: Local repairs to the Collaborative Ithkuil IV spreadsheet, applied by
tools/sync_lexicon.py after each fetch.
'overrides' and 'affixes' each move one root or affix off a form that two
unrelated meanings both claim; a C_R names one root and a C_S one affix, so
carrying both is a defect in the sheet rather than a fact about the language.
'degrees' is the other kind: the row is on the right form and its nine
meanings are missing or belong to a different affix. These are restored
'types' supplies a gradient type the sheet leaves empty. A cell holding
something that is not a type is handled generically by clean_type, not here.
Quijada prints no affix's type anywhere, so this rests on the phonological
signature in §3.5.0.1 and on the shape of the affix's own nine degrees.
verbatim from V_XC_S Affixes for New Ithkuil v1.1, which is Quijada's and
which the sheet is a transcription of, so nothing here is invented.
The reasoning for each is in docs/reference/ERRATA.md under the form.
match_stem0, match_abbrev and match_degree1 identify the broken state, so an
upstream repair simply stops matching and the override falls away instead of
corrupting something.
basis: 'recovered' means the sheet's own series determines the new value.
'chosen' means it does not, and a later upstream repair may pick differently.
A degree override needs no basis: the source states it.

overrides.why: adjacent copy-down; cfy is the empty slot in the cf run and is unused
rosoideae is a complete ten-member run and holds the slot; rţnl is the next free

every suffix in the lzb series is voiced (ḑ w y l r ř z ž v) and bf occurs in 3 roots of 5895 against bz's 138, so the earlier lzbf was wrong; ẓ continues the z/ž sibilants. Weakest of the four: the taxonomy argues psychodomorph is the misplaced row instead
a real double-claim, not a slip; the insect stem carries eight dependants and the clothing root none

affixes.why: upstream gives ḑg to both MDI and S07; MDI is a transposition of gḑ, which no affix uses

degrees: object used or owned for user/owner
degrees.why: blank upstream; ẓd, ẓḑ and zf are three adjacent sheet rows carrying a two-row paste shift, and MET is where it starts
carries MET's nine degrees upstream, from the row above

degrees: sessile, not motile -- adhering to a substrate by direct attachment (not via a stalk/stipe/pedicel/connecting medium)
attached to a substrate via a stalk/stipe/pedicel/connecting medium
degrees.why: carries GPJ's nine degrees upstream, from two rows above; its own list was overwritten and survives only in the affix document

degrees: X times per eon [5 x 10⁸ years]
X times per billion (10⁹) year period
degrees.why: degree 7 upstream reads 'Eight', a stray cell; the affix document has 'X times per eon [5 x 10^8 yrs.]' and the other eight degrees are the same 10^n series
degree 4 upstream reads IMT for the INTERMITTENT Phase; the affix document, morphology.md §3.8 and grammar/slot_viii.go all write ITM

types.why: empty upstream; çx begins with ç, which is Type B's signature, and its degrees run 1-3 on X, 4-6 on X and Y together and 7-9 on X against Y, which is B's three-by-three pattern
